description: Free. Checks a wallet's native gas balance on base/arbitrum/optimism/polygon. If it is at least min, returns needed:false (nothing to pay). Otherwise returns the exact top-up to reach target (default 2 x min), the price with your loyalty fee, an x402 URL to pay (pay_with_x402.url) and, if you hold AgentGas credit, a ready-to-sign credit message (pay_with_credit). Call before each on-chain action.

chain.description: Destination chain for the native gas

payer.description: Paying wallet (loyalty fee, credit). Defaults to to.

target.description: Balance to top up to (default 2 x min)

name: agentgas_ensure_gas
title: Ensure gas
